et nodos historicos aliasque difficulta-tes, quà ἐν φαινομένης
ἀντιλογίας, quà exrei subjectæ qualitate aut circum-

page.notes: The first word of the page, printed "fti" (long s), is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is uncertain. The Greek words after "quà" (ἐν φαινομένης ἀντιλογίας) are copied as printed; the first accent and the ἐν reading are doubtful. "exrei" is printed without a space. The catchword "An" and signature "a" are as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
